# recsat df_FEWS_mean_1 into long format
df_FEWSNET_mean = df_FEWSNET_mean.melt(id_vars=['region_id'], var_name='year_month_band', value_name='FEWSNET_value_mean')


# find split year_month, use band as column name
df_FEWSNET_mean[['year', 'month', 'band']] = df_FEWSNET_mean['year_month_band'].str.split('_', expand=True)

# recast into wide format, use band as column name
df_FEWSNET_mean = df_FEWSNET_mean.pivot(index=['region_id', 'year', 'month'], columns='band', values='FEWSNET_value_mean').reset_index()

# convert region_id, year, monnth to int
df_FEWSNET_mean['region_id'] = df_FEWSNET_mean['region_id'].astype(int)
df_FEWSNET_mean['year'] = df_FEWSNET_mean['year'].astype(int)
df_FEWSNET_mean['month'] = df_FEWSNET_mean['month'].astype(int)

# rename region_id to admin_code
df_FEWSNET_mean = df_FEWSNET_mean.rename(columns={'region_id': 'admin_code'})

# for B1:B28, impute forward
df_FEWSNET_mean.loc[:, 'B1':'B28'] = df_FEWSNET_mean.loc[:, 'B1':'B28'].ffill(axis=0)

# fill the rest with 0
df_FEWSNET_mean.loc[:, 'B1':'B28'] = df_FEWSNET_mean.loc[:, 'B1':'B28'].fillna(0)
# drop duplicates in df_FEWSNET_mean
df_FEWSNET_mean = df_FEWSNET_mean.drop_duplicates(subset=['admin_code', 'year', 'month'], keep='first')
# merge df_FEWS and df_FEWSNET_mean on admin_code, year, month
df_FEWS = pd.merge(df_FEWS, df_FEWSNET_mean, how='left', on=['admin_code', 'year', 'month'], indicator=True)
# for df_FEWS, sort by admin_code, year, month, drop _merge, drop duplicates
df_FEWS = df_FEWS.sort_values(by=['admin_code', 'year', 'month'], ascending=[True, True, True])
# drop _merge
df_FEWS = df_FEWS.drop(columns=['_merge'])
# drop duplicates in df_FEWS
df_FEWS = df_FEWS.drop_duplicates(subset=['admin_code', 'year', 'month'], keep='first')

# impute forward for df_FEWS, column B1:B28
df_FEWS.loc[:, 'B1':'B28'] = df_FEWS.loc[:, 'B1':'B28'].ffill(axis=0)
# fill the rest with 0
df_FEWS.loc[:, 'B1':'B28'] = df_FEWS.loc[:, 'B1':'B28'].fillna(0)
# for df_FEWS, B1:B28, fill missing with 0
df_FEWS.loc[:, 'B3':'B9'] = df_FEWS.loc[:, 'B3':'B9'].fillna(0)
# recast df_FEWSNET_std_1 into long format

# recast df_FEWSNET_std_2 into long format
